description: Compute the opening balance, movement and balance per account at a date from the SIE export. Use it for what is on an account at a date; bokio_account_ledger shows the individual lines. Amounts in ledger sign: debit positive, credit negative.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

date.description: Balance date (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to the fiscal year's last day when fiscalYearId is given, else today.

fiscalYearId.description: Id from bokio_list_fiscal_years; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

name: bokio_account_balances
